correctness.rationale: The killed generator on the positive half-line is solved by reflected OU Gaussian kernels, with correct variance D/kappa*(1-e^-2kappa t) and survival denominator 2Phi(v)-1. The truncated Gaussian integral is analytic in q² after factoring its common interval length, giving exact c2=w(w-3)/6 and c4=w*(3w³-38w²+165w-180)/360; c4(3)=9/20>0. Differentiation of the analytic expansion proves eventual signs. The short-time Gaussian increment gives a strictly negative sqrt(t) correction, yielding at least one strict interior local minimum for 0<w<3 without claiming uniqueness. The independent checker passed 56 symbolic/numerical assertions, including direct integral comparisons. No finite test is treated as an infinite proof.

The directly relevant 2023 paper instead derives integrated residence-time moments and resetting optima; the 2020 work gives survival-conditioned local-time spectral background, not an explicit exceedance-mode phase boundary. Search matches to other quasi-stationary and reset processes were compared by mathematical implication rather than titles alone. Classical reflection and QSD facts are acknowledged; independent publication priority is not asserted.

value.rationale: The exceedance event is the physically natural spatial threshold used to define residence above the reset point. Conditioning by excursion survival selects atypically persistent trajectories, so knowing whether above-threshold occupation approaches its quasi-stationary fraction from above or below is useful for age-resolved observation and integrated residence dynamics. The exact dimensionless Hermite threshold w=3 causes both a compulsory nonmonotone subcritical response and a doubling of the asymptotic relaxation exponent, not a trivial change of units or a table recomputation.
